description: Get a personalized daily hydration target in liters, glasses and fluid ounces from your weight and activity.

faqs.a: It starts at 35 ml per kg of body weight, then adds water for activity level and hot climates. It is a widely used guideline, not a medical prescription.
The toggle adds a flat 500 ml, roughly what extra sweating in heat costs. On very hot or very active days you may need more — drink to thirst and watch urine color.
faqs.q: What does the hot-climate toggle add?

faqs.a: Food also provides water (often 20–30% of intake), so the target covers total water needs, not just what you drink.
faqs.q: Does food count toward the target?

howto: Enter your body weight in kg.
Toggle hot climate if it applies.
Read your target in liters, 250 ml glasses and fluid ounces.
title: Daily Water Intake Calculator
